extracted.intended_audience: mine operators, miners, and MSHA stakeholders (entities required to comply with MSHA reporting and notification rules)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and regulatory reminders about statutory notifications and reporting duties for U.S. mine operators and related stakeholders (e.g., accident reporting timeframe and commencement-of-operations notification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accident reporting timeframe (Part 50 requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mine operators are required by law to report all mining accidents immediately – within 15 minutes of when the operator knew or should have known about the accident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a statutory, time-sensitive reporting requirement directing operators to notify MSHA (e.g., via the emergency/reporting phone number) without delay once an accident is known or should have been known. No additional scoring guidance or examples provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of commencement of operations (30 CFR §56.1000)
rubrics_metrics.description: REMINDER: 30 CFR §56.1000 - Notification of commencement of operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page references the regulatory requirement that operators must notify MSHA when operations commence as required by 30 CFR §56.1000. The page provides a reminder but no expanded text; operators should consult 30 CFR §56.1000 for full procedural details and any timing/format requirements.
